publicReleaseNotes:
**Public subscription choices now match the channels your Lamp can send through.** Email remains available, and SMS, Slack and Teams appear when configured. The Teams form links to instructions for creating a Workflows webhook before asking for its URL, and channel result pages offer a way back to subscriptions.

- **Reopening an incident starts from the component state readers last saw.** Its preview and publication no longer use the incident's old, resolved component attachments as the previous state.
- **Availability report downloads use readable component names.** CSV and PDF filenames use short, file-safe names, with numeric suffixes when names collide.
- **The subscriber directory names selected components.** CSV invitation batches show their import time and remaining count. On a local Lamp, invitation feedback says no email was sent and links to Confirm locally in the Delivery log.
- **Managed mail reports who handles sender authentication.** A configured Run Edit Run relay reports that the platform manages authentication, without claiming inbox delivery. An incomplete managed mail connection gives guidance for restoring it instead of asking for a direct-provider credential.
- **Settings shows the built Lamp version.** The health response also includes `buildVersion` and a version 1 `schemaObservation` with the observed migration count and inventory digest, or a reason the inventory could not be read. This observation is separate from the installation's liveness result.

Upgrading from 1.11.14: back up data and your source changes first, update the checkout to `v1.11.15`, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `rer deploy` with the same environment and input file. This version adds no migrations. The checkout keeps rer 0.2.108. Earlier installations also follow the retained upgrade notes below, including keeping `INSTALLATION_KEY` with their private secrets.

SETUP-002.summary: First-owner setup and website confirmation preserve any valid saved time zone; only an invalid saved zone adopts the browser zone or the existing UTC recovery.
SETUP-002.was: First-run setup: First-run setup begins with the owner's website and lets them edit what the site supplied before confirming the installed page. The original setup decisions are recorded in RULINGS.md. **Acceptance.** 1. Every operator document sends a signed-in owner with no saved first-run completion to setup; a signed-out setup visitor signs in and returns there. 2. Lamp reads the public website once without running scripts, refusing private and loopback addresses at every redirect, and fills only observed page name, tagline, PNG mark, accent and navigation components, plus the browser time zone. 3. A linked Statuspage, Instatus or Better Stack page, or the site's status subdomain, supplies its own components and groups instead of navigation guesses, labeled with their source. 4. Bring its incident history too starts unselected; when selected it imports only resolved incidents and their updates at original times, silently through Move in, without active incidents, maintenance or subscribers. 5. A status feed with no components changes none; an unreadable site or omitted website leaves editable plain defaults with one calm explanation. 6. Confirming stores the edited settings, PNG mark and components and durably marks setup complete; all remain editable in Settings. 7. After completion setup opens the app; migration marks installations with a pre-existing operator complete, and rerunning setup never clears that completion.

migrations.buyerSteps: Apply after 0078 through the ordinary migration runner before starting the updated Worker. Adds the subscriber directory order index; existing subscriber records, consent and delivery history remain unchanged. No account or credential is required.

agentUpdateInstructions: From v1.11.14: back up data and owner source first, update the checkout to v1.11.15, run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (the checkout keeps @runeditrun/rer 0.2.108) and rer deploy with the same environment and input file. This version adds no migrations. Earlier installations first honor the retained release-history records through 1.11.14, including INSTALLATION_KEY provisioning and backup custody. Preserve all published release records, immutable contract snapshots and applied migration history. Preserve the optional LAMP_PAGE_HOST_ROUTE_ZONE and LAMP_PAGE_HOST_TARGET settings (set together, never with LAMP_HOSTING=workers-dev) and every deploy writing page_settings.hostname equal to LAMP_PAGE_HOST. Run the existing verifier and release validator before adopting.
